reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for caffeine pills. That's a question for a doctor or a dietitian, who can account for your health, any medications, and how you react to it.

In general terms, caffeine affects people very differently. Race day is a bad time to try something new, so if you use it at all, stick to what you've already tested in training and use that practice to learn how your stomach and nerves handle it.

If you tell me the race and the date, I can build the training around it.
